artifacts.purpose: Link to source-owned configuration and storage rules

retention_rule.rule: Keep one current link page; do not copy the source philosophy or historical reports

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Regenerate the link page from the source repository

artifacts.purpose: Exclude only rebuildable local tool debris

retention_rule.rule: Keep current ignore policy; private core data stays versioned
Keep while marker-based discovery is used
May remove once the data root contains current data and discovery no longer depends on the placeholder

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Create an empty placeholder during initialization

artifacts.purpose: Current fleet coverage and unresolved failures

retention_rule.rule: Keep only the latest observation; a report is not proof of unobserved systems

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rerun fleet_check.py after proving the current private destination

retention_rule.rule: Keep unresolved entries; remove completed and superseded entries

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rerun the description scan; preserve only useful unapplied choices

artifacts.purpose: Useful rollback descriptions for current edits
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Rollback of a still-relevant description change

retention_rule.rule: Keep only rollback inputs still needed for the current accepted descriptions

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore selected prior descriptions from source Git history

retention_rule.rule: Keep the selected manifest, frozen policy and only its necessary references; retire superseded attempts after extracting a useful conclusion

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rerun the evaluator for the current source candidate; never relabel stale evidence

artifacts.purpose: Research brief and sources needed by current work
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current skill design or requested research brief

retention_rule.rule: Keep current conclusions and necessary sources; remove copied source trees, failed rounds and redundant provider logs

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Refresh research from cited sources and preserve only missing useful conclusions

artifacts.purpose: Requested current maintenance report and its compact supporting measurements
artifacts.schema: Source-owned maintenance output and plan schemas
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: User review and completion of the current maintenance task

retention_rule.rule: Keep requested final deliverables and the minimal current execution evidence; remove obsolete rounds and source/test copies after completion

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rerun the bounded inventory and preserve the selected final conclusion

artifacts.purpose: Transition-only identification of retired development material
artifacts.schema: Historical campaign manifests, not a runtime data contract
artifacts.producer: Retired development workflow; new writes are forbidden
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: One-time extraction of unique useful code and a current conclusion

retention_rule.rule: Remove after every source owner confirms useful changes are merged and current references/writers are gone; never copy the campaign into another archive

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Current source repository and fresh deterministic tests; historical attempts need not be restored

artifacts.purpose: Retain approved shared runtime selection policy
artifacts.schema: Schema-version 1 JSON object with an entries list; each entry has a unique nonempty id and a nonempty exact selector; optional tasks/formats/requires lists contain nonempty strings and may be empty, and tier defaults to main with main/fallback/specialist allowed
artifacts.producer: Operator maintaining reviewed private runtime selection inputs
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Profile Sync runtime input reader and overlay bridge; Smith conflict validation and runtime selection

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current approved policy and unresolved decisions while consumers reference it; replace superseded policy without keeping copied historical files

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore a reviewed PRIVATE companion revision, then review selectors against the current catalog; consumers do not initialize or guess policy

artifacts.purpose: Retain reviewed shared runtime capability observations
artifacts.schema: JSON object with a capabilities mapping keyed by nonempty strings; each observation has a nonempty status string and optional evidence list whose items are nonempty strings; missing or empty evidence is valid, and extra observation date or scope metadata is not interpreted by the shape validator
artifacts.producer: Operator recording reviewed private runtime capability observations
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Profile Sync runtime input reader and overlay bridge; Smith validate_capabilities and capability_gaps

retention_rule.rule: Keep useful current observations and explicit unknown states; review dated evidence before relying on it, since active consumption does not make an old observation current

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore a reviewed PRIVATE companion revision or collect new scoped evidence; preserve unknown status where present support is unverified

artifacts.purpose: Retain approved shared overlay resource bindings
artifacts.schema: JSON object mapping nonempty source-id strings to nonempty resource-root strings; an empty object is valid
artifacts.producer: Operator maintaining reviewed private overlay resource bindings
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Profile Sync runtime input reader and overlay bridge; Smith overlays.build resource_root binding

retention_rule.rule: Keep the active map or explicit empty map while referenced by consumers; remove superseded bindings only after those consumers are reconciled

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore a reviewed PRIVATE companion revision or supply a manually reviewed binding; consumers never guess a resource root

artifacts.schema: JSON object with nonempty receipt keys conventionally naming source-id:relative-path; receipts have nonempty status, artifact_hash string and evidence list whose items are nonempty strings; an empty object, empty artifact hash and empty evidence list are valid uncertified shapes
artifacts.producer: Operator recording reviewed private observations for exact role artifacts
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Profile Sync runtime input reader and overlay bridge document validation and exact-artifact comparison

retention_rule.rule: Keep current observations or an explicit empty uncertified map while referenced; retire superseded observations only after artifact and consumer reconciliation

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore a reviewed PRIVATE companion revision or collect fresh exact-artifact evidence; empty or incomplete receipts do not certify role equivalence
